propositions: The mid-run exception handlers in gate_dispatch.py (produce_plan_review_verdict and _run_code_review_gate) that catch LLMInputRejectedError have no test coverage reaching them, though mutation testing confirms they are not dead code.
The warm-call abort in container_stage._run_container that handles both LLMUnavailableError and LLMInputRejectedError has zero test coverage and zero referencing tests.

Batch-runner exceptions (LLMUnavailableError, LLMInputRejectedError) propagate raw out of run_workflow because _run_batch has no try block, making the plan-review mid-run arm reachable in production via the container warm-abort path.
The code-review mid-run arm is a defensive seam contract where upstream translation/absorption of systemic errors prevents direct propagation; no in-tree production raiser exists today.

New tests must demonstrate both exception types cause degraded INDETERMINATE verdicts with gate_error sidecar emission in gate_dispatch, and both types abort the fan-out (single call, raised) in container warm-call execution.
